name: UPRACE DAY 2026
short_description: UPRACE DAY is on Sunday 1 November 2026 at VNG Campus in Ho Chi Minh City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: UPRACE DAY 2026 is the in-person race day of UpRace, the free community running project VNG Corporation has run since 2018. It takes place on 1 November 2026 at VNG Campus, Z06 Street 13, Tan Thuan ward, Ho Chi Minh City, with Delta Advertising and Trading Co., Ltd. as operator. Distances are 5 km, 10 km and 21 km. The course was not published as text on the Pace8 page; that page labels the event a road race.

core_facts.venue: VNG Campus, Z06 Street 13, Tan Thuan ward
core_facts.organizer: VNG Corporation (operated by Delta Advertising and Trading Co., Ltd.)

faqs.question: What are the age limits and cut-offs at UPRACE DAY 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pace8 page sets a minimum age of 16 for the 21 km and 14 for the 5 km and 10 km. Cut-offs are 4 hours for the 21 km, 2 hours 30 minutes for the 10 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for the 5 km. Runners must bring a national ID card, and under-18s need parental consent.

faqs.question: How much does UPRACE DAY 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: In the regular phase the 21 km costs VND 850,000, the 10 km VND 750,000 and the 5 km VND 650,000. The 21 km includes a finisher shirt. Entries cannot be refunded; changes and transfers are accepted until 23:59 on 15 October 2026.
